description:
Check progress of one verification by the order_id you got when ordering. Once the report is ready, returns what each of the three people saw, separately — not a merged verdict. We do not tell you what to conclude.
按下单时拿到的 order_id 查这一单到哪一步了；已经出报告的话，返回三个人各自看到的内容。
name: get_verification_result
title: 查核实进度和结果
